Sprint 29 — Board 01: the Crashes section on Wealth › Risiko (FR-54, #1421, ADR-0058)

Decided (ADR-0058, signed by the merge of the Sprint 28 planning PR): a section „Crashes“ on Wealth's Risk tab, as idea board 03 drew it: the window, the list (Verlierer · Gewinner · Erholer), the securities (im Depot · ganzer Katalog), eight per list against the crash benchmark's line, „Im Depot ansehen“ opening Bestände with the window as a custom range, and the windows behind a disclosure with their kind, names and names without a window (§9). Losers and winners rank the EUR price return from the window's high to its low, not to each security's own low as board 03 had it (§5). Detection reads the benchmark in its own currency, the lists are in EUR (§7.9). The states the record adds: no crash benchmark (§1), provisional (§2.5, §5), a name without a window (§3).

Proposed here, each recommended option the default unless you comment: P1 the section sits after „Kennzahlen des Portfolios“ (A; flip „Crashes ans Ende“); P2 the window is a select, the first labelled control of one bar built as DESIGN.md's „Labelled controls start on one edge“ component (A; „Crash-Fenster als Chips“); P3 the screen opens on „Im Depot“, the page's view, while the API's default stays the catalogue („Crashes ganzer Katalog zuerst“); P4 it opens on the newest window, the choice kept in the address („Crash-Start tiefstes Fenster“); P5 on a phone the bars stay, two lines per entry (A; „Crashes am Handy als Tabelle“); P6 „Tage bis Vorkrisenkurs“ counts calendar days („Erholer-Tage als Handelstage“); P7 a window before the view's first day shows no „Im Depot ansehen“ and one line why („Depot-Link immer“); P8 without a crash benchmark, a manual window's lists carry no reference line and no Pp. column („Ohne Crash-Benchmark keine Listen“); P9 „Als manuelles Fenster anlegen …“ asks for the low, which a name does not store. Dashed outline: new.

① The default state, in the page (1200 px) recommended

P1 A, P2 A, P3, P4: the Risk page with the new section after the portfolio metrics; the window „Frühjahr 2020“ (detected, named), the list Verlierer, the securities „Im Depot“. Each bar is the EUR price return from the high to the low; the dashed line is the crash benchmark over the same days in EUR (−31,2 %), the fall that detected the window is its own currency's (−33,9 % in USD). Beside each: the difference in percentage points. One sentence of basis stays visible; the method is behind the heading's ⓘ (I1). Names without an answer are counted, never zero.

② „Ganzer Katalog“, and the ⓘ open

In the catalogue, a held security carries „im Depot“, so the two universes read as one list with a marker (proposal; flip „Katalog ohne Depot-Marke“). The ⓘ holds the method: the rule, the currencies, the close lookup, the recovery span, ties, no verdict.

③ Where the window is chosen: a select (A) or chips (B) recommended

A (recommended): one bar, „Fenster“ the first labelled control, so window, list and securities start on one edge at every width; it scales to any number of windows and its option says name, dates and fall. B: one chip per window above the bar: every window visible, one click, but 10–15 chips over twenty years wrap into a block that pushes the list down, and an unnamed window needs a date to tell it apart. Flip: „Crash-Fenster als Chips“.

④ Erholer: complete, and provisional

„Frühjahr 2020“: the rise from each security's own low to the end of the span (the low plus three calendar months, 23.06.2020), the benchmark's rise dashed, and the calendar days until the security first closed at or above its close at the high, or „noch nicht“ (P6; flip „Erholer-Tage als Handelstage“). „Sommer 2026“: the span ends on 21.11.2026, so the list is measured to the last close and says „vorläufig · vollständig am 21.11.2026“.

⑤ An ongoing window

The rule's last window has not recovered: „seit 23.10.2026 · läuft“ in the select, „Tief bisher … vorläufig“ in the window line, and one hint that the low and the lists move while the benchmark falls. „Im Depot ansehen“ works: the range ends today.

⑥ The windows behind the disclosure

Newest first, the ongoing one marked; „erkannt“ muted, „manuell“ in the accent because its dates were chosen by a person; the longest gap in the benchmark's closes per window (§7.8). The rule line names the crash benchmark with „Ändern“ (board 02 ④) and „Fenster anlegen“. Below, the names without a window: one given for the current benchmark whose high moved, one given for a former benchmark that returns when it is chosen again (§3). P9: a name stores only the high's date, so „Als manuelles Fenster anlegen …“ opens a form with the low empty and required.

⑦ No crash benchmark chosen

One data note (UX-DR17, „Hinweis“) with the link to choose one (board 02 ④). Manual windows still work; P8: their lists carry no reference line and no Pp. column, and the basis says so. With no manual window either, the section is the note and an empty state.

⑧ A window before the view's first day

P7: Bestände answers a range before its history with 1 year and the line „Der angefragte Zeitraum passt nicht zu den Daten“ (#1432), so the link would land on the wrong period. The section shows no link and says why; the lists still answer, because „Im Depot“ is today's holdings.

⑨ The phone (390 px), and the privacy mode recommended

A (recommended, P5): the bars stay; each entry is two lines, name and figure over the bar and the Pp. difference; the bar falls into its label column (DESIGN.md rule A). B: table rows without bars, denser, but the comparison with the benchmark is only a number. Flip: „Crashes am Handy als Tabelle“. Privacy mode (FR-51): nothing in the section changes. It hides amounts and quantities on the server; these lists hold percentages, dates and day counts only, which stay (PortfolixirWeb.PrivacyMode). „Im Depot ansehen“ opens Bestände, which hides its amounts there.

⑩ Where the section sits recommended

A (recommended, P1): after „Kennzahlen des Portfolios“, whose „Max. Rückgang“ is the same notion on the view; the page then reads movement before concentration. B: last, after the caps: the existing sections keep their places, but the section that answers „what did the market's falls do“ sits under three that answer „how concentrated“. Flip: „Crashes ans Ende“.
